# Font test fixtures

Downloaded from https://github.com/foliojs/fontkit/tree/master/test/data.
Open Sans is distributed under the Apache License in OpenSans-LICENSE.txt.
Source Sans Pro is distributed under the SIL Open Font License in OFL.txt.
These fonts are regression fixtures, not bundled application fonts.

Roboto-Variable.ttf is from Google Fonts' `ofl/roboto/Roboto[wdth,wght].ttf`:
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/roboto
Its license is Roboto-OFL.txt. SHA-256:
`d7598e12c5dbef095ff8272cfc55da0250bd07fbdecbac8a530b9b277872a134`.

`RectoCffTest-Variable.otf` is a renamed subset of Adobe's Source Serif 4 variable
Roman OpenType font from release `4.005R`. It retains the `wght` and `opsz` axes
and the glyphs used by the PDF regression fixture. See `SourceSerif-OFL.md`.
https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif/tree/4.005R/VAR
